topic: 年度四项验收与后续安排
grammarFocus: 整理仍会复现的错误，形成简短、可执行的考前检查单。
title: Annual Four-Item Review and Follow-Up Planning
prompt: Some organisations hold a single annual review meeting in which four agreed items are assessed together, and all follow-up actions for the coming year are decided at that same meeting. Others prefer to review each item separately at different points in the year and plan follow-up work item by item. Which approach do you think is more effective for an organisation, and why? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类 Task 2 练习，题中情境与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。写作时请先明确你支持的立场（集中年度四项验收，还是分散逐项验收），在引言中直接表明观点；主体段落每段聚焦一个理由，并用具体例子展开，避免只罗列优点。请务必回应“哪种方式对组织更有效”这一比较性问题，而非泛泛讨论会议效率。注意兼顾后续安排（follow-up planning）这一要素，说明你的立场如何影响行动落实。字数不少于 250 词，建议用 5 段结构：引言、两个支持段、一个让步段、结论。
